description: Check Japan journeys with dated routes, explicit fares and source-backed pass constraints.

tools.name: raw_list_autocomplete
tools.description: Fetch bounded bilingual station and place candidates. Required: word. Optional: limit (default: 5), max-nodes (default: 10), multilingual (default: true) (plus 1 more). Returns array of Autocomplete.

tools.name: raw_list_result
tools.description: Fetch route HTML metadata; normalized route commands preserve leg and fare semantics. Optional: date-time, to-id, time-mode (default: start-time) (plus 4 more). Returns the html.

params.name: to-id
params.description: Source arrival station ID (leading zeros significant)

params.name: time-mode
params.description: Source mode: start-time, goal-time, first-operation, last-operation

params.name: from-id
params.description: Source departure station ID (leading zeros significant)
